question: Historical priority and resource efficiency of a trainable 1000-functional-qubit simulated RL policy in XI/Ether
scope: Targeted literature and public-source review, not an exhaustive priority certification

definition.qualifying_agent: The trainable policy or value model evaluates 1000 distinct simulated circuit wires in its decisions; circuit observables influence learned outputs and parameters
not_sufficient: Number of shots, episodes, parameters or state-space dimension
A hypothetical scalable architecture without a reported 1000-wire experiment
definition.bbyq_topology: 250 independent entangled blocks of four wires per agent; all 1000 observations feed a common readout

search_methods: Primary paper abstracts, full texts and appendices
Public qsim source pinned by commit
representative_queries: "Reinforcement Learning Using Quantum Boltzmann Machines" qubits

first_1000_qubit_simulated_qml_model.qualification: The earlier QCNN surrogate and BBY Q use different restricted representations; this does not establish identical algorithms

first_1000_functional_qubit_simulated_qr.finding: No explicit earlier trained 1000-wire RL-policy experiment satisfying the working definition was identified in the sources reviewed
first_1000_functional_qubit_simulated_qr.qualification: Absence from a targeted search is not proof of worldwide priority. Modular independent-circuit RL architectures already existed. The 800-to-1000 width difference alone does not establish a new algorithm or capability.

world_memory_or_speed_record.qualification: Most cited papers do not report comparable peak worker RSS. Installed machine memory is not consumed memory. The new qsim experiment compares identical frozen circuits, not historical full RL campaigns.

trained_on_user_phone.recorded_environment: Linux x86_64 cloud environment with quota 8 vCPU; CI also ran separate jobs

reviewed_sources.title: Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks are Effectively Classically Simulable
reviewed_sources.type: Supervised QML classification; low-bodyness Pauli-shadow surrogate
reviewed_sources.hardware_statement: Resources available on a modern laptop
reviewed_sources.comparison: Earlier broad QML scale, not an RL policy or the same exact block circuit

reviewed_sources.title: It's-A-Me, Quantum Mario: Scalable Quantum Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Chip Ensembles
reviewed_sources.unexecuted_scaling_example: 200 circuits of ten wires, 2000 input dimensions; not reported as an experimental configuration
reviewed_sources.type: DDQN with independent QCNNs and classical aggregation; Super Mario observations
reviewed_sources.comparison: Direct precedent for modular QRL. Same-task learning and resource equivalence have not been measured against BBY Q. Simulated chips do not mean physical machines.

reviewed_sources.title: Hybrid actor-critic algorithm for quantum reinforcement learning at CERN beam lines
reviewed_sources.type: Free-energy RL; classical actor with QBM critic, simulated and quantum annealing
reviewed_sources.comparison: Earlier trained quantum RL models; hardware capacity is not the number of model qubits

reviewed_sources.title: Benchmarking Quantum Reinforcement Learning
reviewed_sources.location: Sections 3-4; comparison of binary and one-hot encoding
reviewed_sources.qualification: These widths describe the stated 3x3 example, not a claimed maximum over every model in the paper
reviewed_sources.type: PQC policy gradient and DQN, free-energy and amplitude-amplification QRL on gridworlds
reviewed_sources.comparison: Provides matched-task methodology and distinguishes sample efficiency from circuit cost; no 1000-wire policy experiment identified

reviewed_sources.title: Reinforcement Learning Using Quantum Boltzmann Machines
reviewed_sources.type: Simulated quantum annealing and QBM-based RL
reviewed_sources.comparison: Earlier QRL learning, with a different representation; no matching 1000-wire experiment identified

reviewed_sources.title: Minor embedding for quantum annealing with reinforcement learning
reviewed_sources.type: PPO constructs minor embeddings for annealing hardware topologies
reviewed_sources.mentioned_scale: Embeddings spanning more than a thousand qubits
reviewed_sources.comparison: Excluded as a direct policy-width precedent: the scale concerns the target embedding, not a demonstrated 1000-wire quantum policy

reviewed_sources.title: Quafu-RL: The cloud quantum computers based quantum reinforcement learning
reviewed_sources.comparison: Do not count the platform's advertised capacity as all qubits functionally used by a trained policy

reviewed_sources.title: Trends in quantum reinforcement learning: State-of-the-arts and the road ahead
reviewed_sources.comparison: The reference to over 1000 fault-tolerant qubits is prospective, not a reported 1000-wire simulated-policy experiment

reviewed_sources.title: qsim public C++ simulator
reviewed_sources.comparison: Public external numerical backend used for new same-circuit measurements, not a historical 1000-wire RL-agent claim

remaining_unknowns: Exhaustive worldwide priority of the precisely defined 1000-wire RL-policy experiment
Comparable process RSS for the reviewed QCNN and Quantum Mario papers
A same-environment, same-optimizer full RL comparison with the Quantum Mario implementation
